# Svelte by LuKaria

## About
Svelte by LuKaria is a medical weight loss clinic based in Jamaica, offering doctor-guided, physician-supervised weight loss programs. We provide personalized care to help patients achieve their health and wellness goals.

## Services
- Medically supervised weight loss
- Physician consultations
- Personalized treatment plans
- Ongoing support and monitoring

## Contact
- Email: svelte@lukariagroup.com
- Phone/WhatsApp: 876-290-3659
- Website: https://www.lukariagroup.com

## Location
- Kingston, St. Andrew, Jamaica

## Key People
- Dr. Kadria Fairclough - Licensed physician specializing in weight loss and lifestyle medicine

## Hours
- Monday-Friday: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM (Jamaica time)

## Care Model
- Virtual-first telehealth consultations across Jamaica
- Registered office for correspondence/verification; no routine walk-in service
